top_signals.title: France is becoming the ‘poster child’ of sovereign debt problems as government borrowing costs hit near 2008 highs
top_signals.summary: France's debt burden and political gridlock are pushing borrowing costs toward levels not seen since 2008.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Grand Canyon Flash Flood Leaves One Dead, 15 Others Missing
top_signals.summary: At least one person died and 15 others may be missing or unaccounted for after a flash flood in the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service said Sunday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Contecon Manzanillo Ready for Ultra Large Container Ships
top_signals.summary: Contecon Manzanillo S.A. de C.V. (CMSA), International Container Terminal Services, Inc.'s (ICTSI) Mexican unit, has paved the way for the Port of Manzanillo to accommodate ultra large container vessels after receiving the go-ahead to handle ships with drafts of up to 15.5 meters.
